parrafo.es: Jim y su equipo atienden llaves de auto, motos, cerraduras residenciales y comerciales en Lakeland y alrededores. Llegan donde estés, con equipo propio para cortar y programar llaves en el momento.
parrafo.en: Jim and his crew handle car keys, motorcycles, and residential and commercial locks around Lakeland. They come to you, with their own equipment to cut and program keys on the spot.

parrafo_1.es: Urban Lock N Key es una cerrajería móvil con base en Lakeland, con licencia para Hillsborough y Polk County. Jim y su equipo atienden autos, motocicletas, residencias y negocios: llaves, controles remotos y cerraduras, cortadas y programadas en el lugar.
parrafo_1.en: Urban Lock N Key is a mobile locksmith based in Lakeland, licensed for Hillsborough and Polk County. Jim and his crew handle cars, motorcycles, homes and businesses: keys, remotes and locks, cut and programmed right on site.

parrafo_2.es: Reseña tras reseña dicen lo mismo: contestan rápido, llegan rápido y resuelven. Dennis Stalk llamó tras quedar encerrado fuera de su camioneta y Jim llegó enseguida; Jake Swenson tuvo una llave nueva para su Ram 1500 en menos de una hora.
parrafo_2.en: Review after review says the same thing: they answer fast, show up fast, and get it done. Dennis Stalk called after getting locked out of his truck and Jim was there right away; Jake Swenson had a new key cut for his Ram 1500 in under an hour.

texto.es: Tal como lo describen sus propios clientes: rápido, confiable y a buen precio.

items.quote: Excellent service and very friendly. Keys work great and they had OEM key blanks in stock for my Kawasaki! He gave me a discount on multiple keys, even had a cool blue one. I'll definitely be back.

I was locked out of my truck due to complications from a previous break-in, and I had somewhere I needed to be. I called, and Jim answered right away. My first question was, "How soon can you get here?"
Jim was great! I was able to get a new FOHBIK key for my ram 1500 within a hour of calling him. Fast, reliable and professional service and at a great price. Thanks Jim!

texto.es: La forma más rápida de pedir ayuda y saber cuánto tarda el equipo en llegar.
texto.en: The fastest way to ask for help and find out how soon the crew can get to you.
